use binary64_types::*;
use serde::{de::DeserializeOwned, Deserialize, Serialize};

const NUMBERS: &[(&str, u64)] = &[
    ("0", 0), ("-0", 0x8000000000000000), ("-0.0", 0x8000000000000000),
    ("9007199254740993", 0x4340000000000000), ("9007199254740995", 0x4340000000000002),
    ("-9007199254740993", 0xc340000000000000), ("-9007199254740995", 0xc340000000000002),
    ("1.00000000000000011102230246251565404236316680908203125", 0x3ff0000000000000),
    ("1.00000000000000011102230246251565404236316680908203126", 0x3ff0000000000001),
    ("1.00000000000000033306690738754696212708950042724609375", 0x3ff0000000000002),
    ("1.7976931348623157e308", 0x7fefffffffffffff),
    ("2.2250738585072014e-308", 0x0010000000000000),
    ("5e-324", 1), ("-5e-324", 0x8000000000000001),
    ("2.4703282292062327e-324", 0), ("2.4703282292062328e-324", 1),
    ("-2.4703282292062327e-324", 0x8000000000000000),
    ("1e-999", 0), ("-1e-999", 0x8000000000000000),
];
const BAD: &[&str] = &[
    "null", "true", "false", "\"-0\"", "[]", "{}",
    "{\"$serde_json::private::Number\":\"-0\"}",
    "{\"$serde_json::private::RawValue\":\"-0\"}",
    "1.7976931348623159e308", "1e999", "-1e999",
    "NaN", "Inf", "Infinity", "+1", "0x1p0", "01", "1.", "1e", "--1", "1 2", "/*x*/1",
];

#[test]
fn finite_rounding_bits_and_serialized_float_identity() {
    for &(token, bits) in NUMBERS {
        let value: EssBinary64 = serde_json::from_str(token).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(value.get().to_bits(), bits, "{token}");
        let wrapped: SampleFloatScalar = serde_json::from_slice(token.as_bytes()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(wrapped.0.get().to_bits(), bits, "{token}");
        let encoded = serde_json::to_string(&value).unwrap();
        assert!(encoded.contains(['.', 'e', 'E']), "{encoded}");
        if bits == 0x8000000000000000 { assert_eq!(encoded, "-0.0"); }
        let again: EssBinary64 = serde_json::from_reader(encoded.as_bytes()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(again.get().to_bits(), bits, "{token} -> {encoded}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn actual_numeric_source_kind_and_finite_construction() {
    for token in BAD {
        assert!(serde_json::from_str::<EssBinary64>(token).is_err(), "{token}");
        assert!(serde_json::from_str::<SampleFloatScalar>(token).is_err(), "{token}");
    }
    for value in [f64::NAN, f64::INFINITY, f64::NEG_INFINITY] {
        assert_eq!(EssBinary64::new(value), Err(EssBinary64Error::NonFinite));
    }
    for &(_, bits) in NUMBERS {
        assert_eq!(EssBinary64::new(f64::from_bits(bits)).unwrap().get().to_bits(), bits);
    }
    assert_eq!(EssBinary64::new(0.0).unwrap(), EssBinary64::new(-0.0).unwrap());
    assert_eq!(EssBinary64Error::NonFinite.to_string(), "Binary64 requires a finite value");
}

fn path<T: DeserializeOwned + Serialize>(template: &str) {
    for token in ["-0", "-1e-999"] {
        let input = template.replace("TOKEN", token);
        let value: T = serde_json::from_str(&input).unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{input}: {error}"));
        let output = serde_json::to_string(&value).unwrap();
        assert!(output.contains("-0.0"), "source sign lost: {input} -> {output}");
    }
    for token in BAD.iter().filter(|token| serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(token).is_ok()) {
        let input = template.replace("TOKEN", token);
        assert!(serde_json::from_str::<T>(&input).is_err(), "accepted {input}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn original_tokens_reach_all_nested_structural_paths() {
    path::<SampleFloatAlias>("TOKEN");
    // Null is an independently admitted Option value; test its non-null scalar path below.
    for token in ["-0", "-1e-999"] {
        let value: SampleFloatItems = serde_json::from_str(&format!("[{token},null]")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(value.0[0].unwrap().get().to_bits(), 0x8000000000000000);
        assert!(value.0[1].is_none());
        let map: SampleFloatNullableMap = serde_json::from_str(&format!("{{\"x\":{token},\"none\":null}}")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(map.ess_extra["x"].unwrap().get().to_bits(), 0x8000000000000000);
        assert!(map.ess_extra["none"].is_none());
    }
    path::<SampleFloatDictionary>("{\"x\":TOKEN}");
    path::<SampleFloatMapAlias>("{\"x\":TOKEN}");
    path::<SampleFloatMaps>("{\"x\":{\"y\":TOKEN}}");
    path::<SampleFloatListMap>("{\"x\":[TOKEN]}");
    path::<SampleFloatChoice>("{\"value\":\"number\",\"content\":TOKEN}");
    path::<SampleFloatChoiceMap>("{\"x\":{\"value\":\"number\",\"content\":TOKEN}}");
    path::<SampleFloatRecord>("{\"required\":TOKEN,\"dictionary\":{},\"children\":[]}");
    path::<SampleFloatRecord>("{\"required\":1,\"optional\":TOKEN,\"dictionary\":{},\"children\":[]}");
    path::<SampleFloatRecord>("{\"required\":1,\"dictionary\":{},\"children\":[{\"required\":TOKEN,\"dictionary\":{},\"children\":[]}]}");
    path::<SampleFloatNested>("{\"value\":\"dictionary\",\"content\":{\"x\":TOKEN}}");
    path::<SampleFloatNested>("{\"value\":\"record\",\"content\":{\"required\":TOKEN,\"dictionary\":{},\"children\":[]}}");
    for token in ["1e999", "\"1\"", "{}"] {
        assert!(serde_json::from_str::<SampleFloatItems>(&format!("[{token}]")).is_err());
        assert!(serde_json::from_str::<SampleFloatNullableMap>(&format!("{{\"x\":{token}}}")).is_err());
    }
}

#[test]
fn presence_union_alternatives_and_prior_value_boundary() {
    assert!(serde_json::from_str::<SampleFloatRecord>("{\"dictionary\":{},\"children\":[]}").is_err());
    let record: SampleFloatRecord = serde_json::from_str("{\"required\":0,\"dictionary\":{},\"children\":[]}").unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(record.optional, EssPresence::Absent));
    let text: SampleFloatChoice = serde_json::from_str("{\"value\":\"text\",\"content\":\"-0\"}").unwrap();
    assert!(serde_json::to_string(&text).unwrap().contains("\"-0\""));
    let prior: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str("-0").unwrap();
    let converted: EssBinary64 = serde_json::from_value(prior).unwrap();
    let arbitrary_precision = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>("1.50").unwrap().to_string() == "1.50";
    assert_eq!(arbitrary_precision, std::env::var("ESS_EXPECT_ARBITRARY_PRECISION").as_deref() == Ok("1"));
    if arbitrary_precision {
        assert_eq!(converted.get().to_bits(), 0, "Value conversion has already lost lexical sign");
    } else {
        // Without the feature a Value holds the binary64 itself; the boundary stays outside the
        // codec contract because a consumer's graph may unify the feature on.
        assert_eq!(converted.get().to_bits(), (-0.0_f64).to_bits(), "a binary64 Value keeps its sign");
    }
    assert!(EssBinary64::deserialize(serde::de::value::F64Deserializer::<serde::de::value::Error>::new(1.0)).is_err());
}

/// A nullable `Optional<Binary64>` member, declared `null_when_absent` or `omitted_or_null`, in a
/// declared struct and in a command's input and response roots
/// (story:a-null-when-absent-binary64-field-realizes). Each body is compared as the whole
/// re-encoded document, so a present `null` must come back as a key; each member is read through
/// the finite Binary64 codec's type. The cases marked "adversary" are the D350 U1 adversary's
/// pass-1 cases, moved here so that no test spawns a build of its own.
mod nullable {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::Value;

    const NEGATIVE_ZERO: u64 = 0x8000000000000000;

    fn written<T: DeserializeOwned + Serialize>(text: &str) -> String {
        let decoded: T = serde_json::from_str(text).unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{text}: {error}"));
        serde_json::to_string(&decoded).unwrap()
    }

    /// The body decodes and is written back as the same JSON document, keys and `null`s included.
    fn round_trips<T: DeserializeOwned + Serialize>(text: &str) -> T {
        let out = written::<T>(text);
        let read: Value = serde_json::from_str(text).unwrap();
        let back: Value = serde_json::from_str(&out).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back, read, "{text} was written back as {out}");
        serde_json::from_str(text).unwrap()
    }

    fn refuses<T: DeserializeOwned>(text: &str) {
        assert!(serde_json::from_str::<T>(text).is_err(), "{text} decodes");
    }

    fn bits(value: Option<EssBinary64>) -> Option<u64> {
        value.map(|value| value.get().to_bits())
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_null_when_absent_response_field_decodes() {
        let present: SampleFloatMeasureResponse = round_trips("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":1.5}");
        assert_eq!(bits(present.value), Some(1.5f64.to_bits()));
        let absent: SampleFloatMeasureResponse = round_trips("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":null}");
        assert_eq!(bits(absent.value), None);
        round_trips::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":1.5,\"spare\":2.5}");
        round_trips::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":null,\"spare\":null}");
        let zero: SampleFloatMeasureResponse = serde_json::from_str("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":-0}").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(bits(zero.value), Some(NEGATIVE_ZERO));
        refuses::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\"}");
        refuses::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":\"1.5\"}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_published_input_example_decodes() {
        let example: Value = serde_json::from_str(EXAMPLE).unwrap();
        let expected: Value = serde_json::from_str("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":null}").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(example, expected, "the published input example");
        let decoded: SampleFloatMeasureInput = round_trips(EXAMPLE);
        assert_eq!(bits(decoded.value), None);
        let present: SampleFloatMeasureInput = round_trips("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":1.5}");
        assert_eq!(bits(present.value), Some(1.5f64.to_bits()));
        refuses::<SampleFloatMeasureInput>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\"}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_null_when_absent_struct_field_decodes() {
        let present: SampleFloatReading = round_trips("{\"value\":1.5}");
        assert_eq!(bits(present.value), Some(1.5f64.to_bits()));
        let absent: SampleFloatReading = round_trips("{\"value\":null}");
        assert_eq!(bits(absent.value), None);
        round_trips::<SampleFloatReading>("{\"value\":1.5,\"spare\":2.5,\"plain\":3.5}");
        let zero: SampleFloatReading = serde_json::from_str("{\"value\":-0}").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(bits(zero.value), Some(NEGATIVE_ZERO));
        refuses::<SampleFloatReading>("{\"spare\":2.5}");
        refuses::<SampleFloatReading>("{\"value\":\"1.5\"}");
    }

    /// Adversary: a `null` is written back as a present `null`.
    #[test]
    fn a_null_is_written_back_as_a_present_null() {
        for text in [
            "{\"value\":null}",
            "{\"value\":null,\"spare\":null}",
            "{\"value\":1.5,\"spare\":null,\"plain\":2.5}",
        ] {
            round_trips::<SampleFloatReading>(text);
        }
        for text in [
            "{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":null}",
            "{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":null,\"spare\":null}",
            "{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":1.5}",
        ] {
            round_trips::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>(text);
        }
        round_trips::<SampleFloatMeasureInput>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":null}");
    }

    /// Adversary: a token past the binary64 range is refused at every nullable member.
    #[test]
    fn a_nullable_member_refuses_a_token_past_the_binary64_range() {
        refuses::<SampleFloatReading>("{\"value\":1e400}");
        refuses::<SampleFloatReading>("{\"value\":null,\"spare\":-1e400}");
        refuses::<SampleFloatReading>("{\"value\":null,\"plain\":1e400}");
        refuses::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":1e400}");
        refuses::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":null,\"spare\":1e400}");
        refuses::<SampleFloatMeasureInput>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":1e400}");
    }

    /// Adversary: an integer token past 2^53 is read as the nearest binary64.
    #[test]
    fn a_nullable_member_reads_the_nearest_binary64() {
        for (text, key) in [
            ("{\"value\":9007199254740993}", "value"),
            ("{\"value\":null,\"spare\":9007199254740993}", "spare"),
            ("{\"value\":null,\"plain\":9007199254740993}", "plain"),
        ] {
            let out = written::<SampleFloatReading>(text);
            let back: Value = serde_json::from_str(&out).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(back[key].as_f64(), Some(9007199254740992.0), "{out}");
            assert!(!out.contains("9007199254740993"), "{text} kept its exact token: {out}");
        }
        let out = written::<SampleFloatMeasureResponse>("{\"sample_id\":\"s-1\",\"value\":9007199254740993}");
        assert!(!out.contains("9007199254740993"), "the response kept its exact token: {out}");
    }
}
